mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_id, event_version, occurred_at, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, payload_hash, delivery_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, delivered_time, last_error, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_flow_notify_outbox current_event WHERE retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( (delivery_status IN (0, 3) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (delivery_status = 1 AND lock_time <= #{staleBefore}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_notify_outbox previous_event WHERE previous_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND previous_event.aggregate_type = current_event.aggregate_type AND previous_event.aggregate_id = current_event.aggregate_id AND previous_event.id < current_event.id AND previous_event.delivery_status != 2 ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_flow_notify_outbox current_event LEFT JOIN sys_flow_notify_outbox previous_event ON previous_event.tenant_id = current_event.tenant_id AND previous_event.aggregate_type = current_event.aggregate_type AND previous_event.aggregate_id = current_event.aggregate_id AND previous_event.id < current_event.id AND previous_event.delivery_status != 2 SET current_event.delivery_status = 1, current_event.retry_count = current_event.retry_count + 1, current_event.lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, current_event.lock_time = #{now}, current_event.next_retry_time = NULL, current_event.update_time = #{now} WHERE current_event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_event.id = #{id} AND current_event.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND previous_event.id IS NULL AND ( (current_event.delivery_status IN (0, 3) AND (current_event.next_retry_time IS NULL OR current_event.next_retry_time <= #{now})) OR (current_event.delivery_status = 1 AND current_event.lock_time <= #{staleBefore}) )
